proposedBiography: Jonathan Sacks was a rabbi, philosopher, and author who served as Chief Rabbi of the United Hebrew Congregations of the Commonwealth from 1991 to 2013. His books explore religion and science, moral responsibility, Jewish thought, and relations between religious communities.
